exposure: International Association of Diabetes in Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) criteria
National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) diagnostic criteria for GDM
cohort: 4,033 pregnant women and their offspring in Finland in 2009
finding: GDM prevalence was higher with IADPSG criteria compared to NICE criteria, but LGA rates were similar; both IADPSG and NICE diagnosed GDM were associated with higher risks of induced delivery and CS compared to controls.
mod_finding: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus, regardless of the diagnostic criteria used, had a higher risk of induced delivery and cesarean sections compared to women without gestational diabetes mellitus.
birth_weight: Measured and compared using birth weight SD score (BWSDS)
